intervention.duration: 3 days (replaced daily); results text says 48 h
intervention.description: Pharynx-containing trunk fragments from untreated worms placed in 127 uM 1-octanol (8-OH) within 30 min of cutting, solution renewed daily for 3 days, then spring water to day 21.

readout.method: dissecting-microscope scoring of eyes at each end (DH = at least one eye on each side)

notes: Text: N=593, 25% DH, 72% normal single-headed (cryptic), ~3% indiscriminate shapes lacking eyes. Fig 1A legend gives N=573 for the same 72%/25%; methods say 2.1% eyeless radial. Counts converted from percent with N=593. 'other' = eyeless regenerates with indiscriminate/radial body plan. Exposure duration: methods 3 days of daily renewal, results text '48 h'. Pooled over replicates over several months (counts not given per replicate).
